title: Chronological Sorting
description: Verify upcoming appointments display ordered by date/time in ascending chronological order
precondition: Patient user is logged in. Multiple scheduled active appointments populated.
test_step_description: Navigate directly into the 'My Appointments' page grid dashboard view.
test_step_expected_result: Portal interface correctly orders appointments chronologically ascending (earliest upcoming date maps first at top row position).

title: Accessibility - WCAG AA
description: Verify screen reader element tag descriptions on custom grid cards meet compliance standards
test_step_description: Inspect keyboard tab focus sequence traversals across the list elements components.
test_step_expected_result: All interactive containers emit accurate ARIA accessibility labels matching standard WCAG AA specification perimeters cleanly.

title: Cancelled Expiry Visibility
description: Verify visibility lifecycle properties for cancelled appointments past their expiration
precondition: Current mock test framework execution time maps to 2026-07-16 13:00.
test_step_description: Trigger page view lookup refresh command parameters.
test_step_expected_result: Cancelled appointments automatically stop rendering in upcoming list sections completely once their originally scheduled hour has passed.

title: Local Time Zone Conversion
description: Verify appointment times match user local target time zones automatically
precondition: Server database time stamps persist tracking configurations natively in UTC.
test_step_description: Evaluate display text fields for the specific appointment scheduling elements.
test_step_expected_result: System automatically translates runtime timestamps into local parameters, rendering output value as 10:00 AM EST without backend data drift.
